notes.title: [THE HANGED MAN] Chinese language support update and the commemorative sale!
notes.notes:
To all of our fans,

Thank you for playing The BOOGIE Man.

We are pleased to announce that we have added Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese to the supported languages for The Hanged Man, the final chapter of “The Strange Man” series.

To celebrate, all four titles in “The Strange Man” series, The Crooked Man, The Sand Man, The Boogie Man, and The Hanged Man will be on sale for 50% off for one week from March 15th, 2:00 AM to March 22nd, 2:00 AM (JST).
This is the perfect chance to enjoy the series if you haven’t already so grab your copies today!

notes.title: Patch: Added Korean to supported languages.
notes.notes:
Dear Fans,
 
Thank you for playing The Boogie Man.
This message is to inform you that a new update has gone live.

[b]Update Details[/b]
 
[list]
[*]Added Korean to supported languages.
[*]Fixed issue where a character tip from a different scene is shown.
[*]Fixed translation errors in English and Chinese.
[*]Fixed issue where control inputs wouldn't be read under certain conditions.
[/list] 
 
Again, thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: New PLAYISM Title: Giraffe and Annika Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear PLAYISM fans,

We are writing to inform you that today marks the release of our newest title.

Heartfelt 3D Action+Rhythm Action game, Giraffe and Annika.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1122100/Giraffe__Annika/
